$comment: Single source of truth for every version, milestone, contract and count quoted in the pkinative documentation. scripts/verify-docs.ts holds package.json, CITATION.cff, CHANGELOG.md and the prose to it; update this file, not the prose. verifiedOn is the date of the last documentation audit.

pkinative.npm: not published; pre-1.0 versions are git tags with an attested release tarball, the first npm publication is 1.0.0

bundle.$comment: Byte budgets for what dist/ ships, enforced by the bundle-check gate step. verify:bundle budgets the re-minified bundle and says nothing about the shipped files. The source maps ship on purpose (tsup.config.ts sourcemap: true): a parsing library's stack traces are worth 2.6x the code when the source is MIT and already public. Every file of dist/ must have an entry, and raising one is a reviewed diff. Raised twice at 0.3.0, once per half of the milestone: for the crypto layer, measured 170281/171452/80501/80501/472771/472774; then for the build layer, measured 188455/190308/109647/109647/535650/535653. The declaration files grew 36 % against 11 % for the code, which is the surface the byte budget cannot see and declared.typeSurface can. Raised again at 0.5.0 for revocation and OCSP, measured 247184/249342/157003/157003/736695/736698 at +12 %. The declaration files are the fastest-growing artefact and declared.typeSurface is what makes that visible: 197 exports now, 115 of them types. Raised once more at 0.5.0 for the purpose check and the verify layer, measured 270984/273327/182552/182552/841166/841169 at +10 %. dist/index.d.ts is now 182552 bytes: the 1.0 trigger written down in the plan is 200000, past which subpath exports get reconsidered as a whole rather than one at a time. Raised at 0.7.0 for CMS and RFC 3161, measured 389073/391794/258879/258879/1241462/1241465 at +43 %: the largest rise so far, for a whole subsystem with its parser, builder and two verdicts. dist/index.d.ts has now passed that 200000 trigger. The decision stays where the plan put it, at 1.0 and for the whole partition at once: a subpath added now would freeze a module split before keys/ exists. Raised at 0.8.0 for PKCS#8 and PKCS#12, measured 445030/448014/294325/294325/1407559/1407562 at +14 %: keys/ now exists, so the partition the 1.0 decision will weigh is complete.

typeSurface.$comment: The declaration file's real driver. Bytes drift with TSDoc wording, so a byte budget alone can be raised without anyone noticing that the surface doubled; these two counts cannot change by accident. Derived from docs/assets/api.json and held to it by type-surface-parity. Revisit subpath exports at 1.0 if dist/index.d.ts passes 200000 bytes.

playgroundBundle.$comment: The playground runs a byte-for-byte copy of dist/index.js, because pkinative is not on npm before 1.0.0 and there is no CDN to load it from. sourceSha256 fingerprints every src/**/*.ts and tsup.config.ts; bundleSha256 and bytes describe the committed copy. All three are written by `npm run docs:playground` — never by hand — and `playground-freshness` fails when a source changed without a rebuild. maxBytes is the one hand-set field. Raised from 300000 to 400000 at 0.7.0 for the CMS and RFC 3161 layers, measured 389073: the copy is dist/index.js byte for byte, so it moves with the bundle budget above and cannot be trimmed on its own. Raised to 470000 at 0.8.0 for PKCS#8 and PKCS#12, measured 445030.

socialImages.$comment: svgSha256 is the SHA-256 of the LF-normalised SVG: it is what proves the committed PNG is not stale. Re-rasterise with the command in the SVG's header comment, then update this hash in the same commit.
